name: The Mirage Tale
source:
Ashley finds a new friend when Jenny moves into her neighbourhood, but the relation soon takes a romantic turn. Why does Ashley a feel strange attraction towards her? A short girl-meets-girl tale.

[From [url=http://luxhime.wordpress.com/2010/04/06/the-mirage-tale-released/]Lux Visual Novels[/url]]
translation:
珍妮搬到附近後，艾希莉結識了一位新朋友，但兩人之間卻很快萌生了愛意。艾希莉為什麼會如此受她吸引？這是一個女孩邂逅女孩的短篇故事。

[摘自[url=http://luxhime.wordpress.com/2010/04/06/the-mirage-tale-released/]Lux Visual Novels[/url]]
